Now rule 5: If something is young then it is smart. Young → Smart. Erin is young → Erin is smart (we already have smart, but okay). Also rule 2: Young things are furry. Young → Furry. So Erin young → Erin is furry.

Thus we have derived Erin is furry.

Thus ¬Furry(Erin) is false given the facts and rules. So the statement "Erin is not furry" does NOT follow; it's contradicted.
